values./system/biography: An eccentric waterproofed Mister Handy and accomplished sailor who captains the Nautilus.
values./items/@f062c2588e617c93/system/descript: This character is a robot: it cannot use consumables or heal naturally, and damage must be repaired. It is immune to hunger, thirst and suffocation.
values./items/@d5e3703bf8246d5f/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/@08a44980c0f64557/system/descript: This character cannot suffer damage or effects from poison.
values./items/@0399da2a05bb6679/system/descript: Rudy has 360-degree vision and ignores difficult ground terrain.
values./items/@9bc7e096d6a778cf/system/descript: Rudy suffers no underwater damage and may reroll 1d20 on one underwater Athletics test per scene.
